purpose: Fail-closed production inventory of Agentlas Statistics against an independently normalized taxonomy derived from official MathWorks documentation. This is not a compatibility or equivalence claim.

statusVocabulary.implemented: The exact Agentlas ID has a production implementation and contract evidence for this axis; this does not imply coverage of the surrounding MATLAB category.
statusVocabulary.partial: A bounded subset or unbound catalog declaration exists, but MATLAB-category workflow coverage or end-to-end production evidence is incomplete.
statusVocabulary.missing: No production-bound exact-ID capability satisfies this axis.
statusVocabulary.not-applicable: This axis does not apply to this inventory row and contributes no parity credit.

officialTaxonomySources.title: Interactively Explore and Analyze Plotted Data

claimPolicy.allowedStatement: Agentlas Statistics implements 167 bounded analysis methods and catalogs 64 figure templates; MATLAB-category renderer, interaction, and export parity is not implemented.
denialReasons: All 95 exact-ID rows lack complete production-bound MATLAB-category interaction parity; the response-surface template has only bounded orbit, pan, zoom, and persisted-view interaction.
All renderer rows are partial or missing; one bounded masked response-surface renderer does not cover the remaining four numeric-3d template IDs or the MATLAB plot taxonomy.
All export rows are partial or missing; response-surface canvas capture does not supply template-bound PDF, EPS, TIFF, CMYK, font-embedding, or multipage parity.
The 167 exact engine methods are a bounded subset of the official Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox taxonomy.

analysis: Probability-family breadth beyond normal, zero-location lognormal and zero-location exponential, plus calibrated goodness-of-fit inference
ANCOVA, MANOVA, repeated-measures and mixed-effects breadth
random slopes, crossed or nested random effects, and broader mixed-effects inference
supervised and semi-supervised machine learning breadth
factor analysis, feature selection and broader dimensionality reduction
DOE, reliability and statistical process control
renderer: Production binding from each catalog template ID to emitted data and marks
3-D point clouds, volume slices, vector fields and trajectories beyond the bounded response surface
geographic, polar, animation and general image plot families
full axes, object-property, annotation, tiled-layout and multi-axis authoring
interaction: Zoom, pan, and persisted view state outside the bounded response-surface renderer
3-D rotation outside the bounded response-surface renderer
export: exact physical sizing and padding across all templates
journal validation of line width, typography and vector/raster choice
